# Great Connections, Greater Impact:
HCSG Takes on FNCE 2026


[Careers](https://www.hcsgcorp.com/blog/category/careers/) ,


[Nutrition](https://www.hcsgcorp.com/blog/category/nutrition/)


Another FNCE is in the books, and the Healthcare Services Group (HCSG) clinical team is still buzzing. The booth was full of energy, conversation, and generosity from attendees who stopped by to connect, learn, and give back.


****Where Careers Took Off****


Day One kicked off with ‘Coffee & Careers’, where attendees could grab a complimentary barista-made coffee and connect with HCSG dietitians. They could ask questions, hear about their day-to-day work, and learn how RDs build careers with HCSG.


As the day went on, attendees could participate in our four-stop Career Passport activity that delved deeper into the company and the opportunities available for dietitians. Stations were built around the following themes:


- **Meet:** Chat with an HCSG RD about life and growth at HCSG.
- **Discover:** Take the[“What’s Your RD Path?”](https://www.hcsgcorp.com/rd-career-survey/) quiz to find your best-fit path.
- **Explore:** Check out HCSG career opportunities.
- **Connect:** Stop by our Coffee + Careers or Mocktails + Mentors bar to connect.


Attendees who completed all four stops were entered into a grand-prize drawing for a $500 American Express travel voucher. ***“The career passport was a great way to quickly determine the attendee’s interest—whether they were looking for a job opportunity or simply wanted to know more about us,”*** expressed Senior Director of Operations Erin DeLain.


For a mid-day break on day two, attendees were invited to order a mocktail and network with team members during our ‘Mocktails & Mentors’ event. It was a relaxed way to talk about career goals, get advice, and meet mentors who could help guide their next steps.


Time at the HCSG booth also gave attendees a chance to join our ‘Hot Take’ station and share their thoughts on various nutrition topics. Fresh vs. frozen produce? Is breakfast the most important meal of the day? What is one myth about dietitians? To find out what attendees and HCSG RDs had to say, follow along as we share their responses on our[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/thehcsg/) page.


****Giving Back, One Tote at a Time****


Connecting with attendees was important, but so was giving back. HCSG used FNCE as a unique opportunity to raise money for the[Going Beyond Assistance Fund](https://www.gbaf.org/) , which provides financial assistance to HCSG employees and their families facing unexpected hardships. Thanks to attendees’ generosity, they helped raise more than **$2,100** by purchasing food-pun tote bags.


******Keep the Connections Going******


FNCE is a great place to meet fellow RDs, but the conversation doesn’t have to end when the conference does.[HCSG](http://hcsg.com/nutrition) is one of the nation’s largest networks of registered dietitians, and we’re always looking for passionate professionals who want to put their expertise towards improving lives. Joining us means growing your career, connecting with colleagues, and making a meaningful difference in the communities we serve.


Curious about what’s next for you?[Schedule a brief screening call with one of our recruiters.](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/u/0/appointments/schedules/AcZssZ32k9dMwWV8v8QD1oVY_rmyEi70onzWARUFW7X9-TBVNQH_pW5FfxyxCpd30E7TXu9ZPXlrIAN_) You can talk through your interests, explore available RD roles, and learn how we can support your career goals. Explore all opportunities at[RD.Careers.](https://hcsgcareers.com/registered-dietitians)
